Article 2 (Notification of Lists of Persons Eligible for Selection, etc.)
The Commissioner of the Military Manpower Administration shall notify the Minister of National Defense of the lists of persons eligible for selection as active-duty commissioned officers in the legal field (hereinafter referred to as "legal officers"), the physical grades determined at their final physical examinations, and the results of their background investigations, by the respective deadlines for the following categories:
1. Persons under Article 118 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Service Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree"): By May 1 of the year in which they are commissioned.
2. Persons under Article 119-3 (1) of the Decree: By the following respective deadlines:
(a) Persons scheduled to complete the Judicial Research and Training Institute program: By December 20 of the year preceding the year in which they complete the program;
(b) Persons who have graduated from a law school and passed the bar examination: Within five days after announcement of the successful applicants in the bar examination.
